name: repository-delivery
description: Preservation-aware repository delivery, snapshot-bound evidence and optional fenced integrations.

codex.notes: Codex support is delivered through the native AOK Codex plugin bundle; generated pack output should retain plugin metadata from .codex-plugin/plugin.json.
codex.importInstructions: Use the bundled repository-delivery skills and helper support tree; read docs/repository-delivery.md in AOK. Python 3.11+ is optional and required only for delivery helper operations.

claude-code.notes: Claude Code support is a compatibility marketplace bundle backed by preserved pack assets, not a separate operating model.
